title: Atomic Number
short: Find the element's number of protons.
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on find the element's number of protons.
Tip: The atomic number is the element's identity: hydrogen 1, carbon 6, gold 79. In the table it is the small whole number.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
